_comment: Phrases scripts/ci/docs-slop.mjs looks for in the prose of changed Markdown (issue #943). `error` fails the run: only phrases with near-zero legitimate use in technical writing. `warn` is printed and never fails: words with real technical uses. `pattern` is a case-insensitive regular expression. Code, links, quotations and the files in `ignore` are skipped. Lists of these phrases (doc-unslop, docs-style, the research report) are in `ignore`. Tune this file from the output of `node scripts/ci/docs-slop.mjs --all`.

phrases.reason: AI vocabulary that says nothing; name the thing
inflated metaphor
claims significance instead of showing it
claims importance with no evidence; say what it does
filler that delays the point; state the point
restates what was just said
a run-up before the content
